title: AgentChain
tagline: Decentralized AI Agents for Proactive Smart Wallets,Outline the tech stack (Solidity, ERC-4337, OpenAI API, Next.js, RainbowKit, Safe SDK, The Graph).
description:
A brief summary outlining the problem, your innovative solution with AI-powered gas fee suggestions and auto-approvals, and the benefits of Account Abstraction.
AgentChain was born out of the desire to transform passive wallets into proactive tools. We wanted a wallet that could not only track gas fees and manage transactions but also leverage AI to suggest optimal fees and even auto-approve transactions based on predefined rules. Given the time constraints of a hackathon, we focused on building a proof-of-concept that integrated cutting-edge blockchain features with AI insights.
how_its_made:
AgentChain stands as a prototype that showcases the future of decentralized wallets—one that’s not only secure and cost-efficient but also smart enough to anticipate and manage transactions proactively. The blend of partner technologies, even if integrated in a somewhat hacky fashion, was crucial in making this vision a reality within the tight hackathon timeline.

By piecing together these diverse technologies, we created a platform that hints at what’s possible when blockchain and AI work in tandem. We’re excited about the potential improvements and refinements that can be made, and we believe AgentChain paves the way for more intuitive and efficient wallet experiences in Web3.
